race.comment: IMELDA (3) runs in a race without much good exposed form. She did run here and ran well over a distance which looks too short on breeding alone. Now out another furlong, it is easy to see her sitting midfield and running over the top of them. MISSION STRIKE (2) is a former Hong Kong horse who must not have enjoyed the circumstances there so came home and has had two trials. The market will tell. CRISPY LEAVES (4) did not have the best of luck in a better race at Newcastle. She does get into a more appropriate maiden for what she has shown to date. ELDIRON (1) showed nothing at the debut but that was a while ago. Place is probably the best chance. COOL ART (7) was comfortably held last time over 1100m at Scone. Blinkers go on and look for improvement.
